definitions.coverage: native full bins versus common trial endpoints on 100ms grid
definitions.fano: sample count variance / mean count; null if mean=0 or fewer than 2 bins
definitions.mean_rate_hz: total spikes / total observed seconds for each unit
definitions.nonstationarity: bins mix task epochs, conditions, and train/val trials; descriptive Fano is not repeated-trial noise variability
definitions.population: sum of counts over all 142 units; rate in population spikes/s
definitions.sparsity: observed zero-count cells / observed cells; -1 is missing
definitions.variance: sample variance of counts across equal-duration temporal bins, ddof=1

metadata_audit.limitations: Candidate +96 links reproduce the publisher convention, not independent anatomical verification; no corrections applied.
metadata_audit.publisher_note: Prefix 1 denotes PMd, 2 denotes M1; publisher documents M1 indices shifted by +96
